verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show the rcli tool takes natural-language voice commands such as 'navigate to google.com in safari'. The same tester found it reported success without doing the action, and the vendor's reply calls this a known limitation of small-model tool calling. The SDK's voice-agent and tool-calling features are building blocks for developers, not ways to operate the product itself, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing natural-language operation of the product, reliable execution of commands, and coverage of natural-language control beyond the rcli demo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Just tried it, really cool, fun tech demo with rcli.
